title: Consent endpoints answer 202, and 422 for a wrong consentOperation (protocol-07 §5.7)
description: ietf-wg-mimi/mimi-protocol#173 (Mark, merged 2026-11-01) changes §5.7 in the editor's copy: requestConsent and updateConsent answer 202 Accepted (not 201), and a consentOperation not allowed on the endpoint gets 422 Unprocessable Content (mimid: 400, decision mimid-1wgh.7.37, which marked the status INVENTED because -06 named none). The editor's copy is 'Ready to submit draft-ietf-mimi-protocol-07' (merge of #183). Per the target-the-latest-published-draft policy (cf. .5.74), apply when -07 is published: inbound 202 on accept, 422 for WrongOperation (other .7.37 violations stay 400 unless -07 says otherwise); PeerClient::request_consent/update_consent expect 202; update tests (consent_endpoints.rs, peer_consent.rs) to the -07 text; supersede the wrong-operation part of .7.37; refresh AGENTS.md spec table to protocol -07 (separate check of everything else -07 changed).
design: The published draft-ietf-mimi-protocol-07 §5.7 text is spliced (txt L2355-2370 and L2439-2449): a stale fragment of the -06 paragraph ("201 Accepted ... Likewise in response to a cancel which has no request matching the" / "A provider that does not") runs into the complete new paragraph from ietf-wg-mimi/mimi-protocol#173. Readings: (a) the stale 201 fragment still has force; (b) only the complete new text governs. Chosen: (b) — the fragment breaks off mid-sentence and is a merge artifact (reported upstream as #186, fix PR #187; wg bead mimid-1wgh.37.96). requestConsent and updateConsent answer 202 Accepted on receipt, including a cancel with no matching request; 404 for an unknown local user stays per decision mimid-1wgh.7.36 (-07 still allows it). A consentOperation the endpoint does not take (requestConsent: not request/cancel; updateConsent: not grant/revoke) gets 422 Unprocessable Content. Supersedes the wrong-operation part of decision mimid-1wgh.7.37; its INVENTED 400 still covers domain, path and From violations, for which -07 names no status. PeerClient expects 202 and treats any other status, including 201, as a rejection.
notes: 2026-11-02: deferred to 2026-11-09 to check whether draft-ietf-mimi-protocol-07 is published (datatracker); re-defer if not.
close_reason: Consent endpoints answer 202, 422 for wrong consentOperation (protocol-07 §5.7, this decision); PeerClient expects 202. Tests failed first (201 vs 202, 400 vs 422, Rejected{202}). Six gates pass on main.
